press_references.value: Micropolis Robotics Expands Industrial Automation Footprint with USD $1.2 Million EMSTEEL Agreement

partnership_announcements.description: Micropolis AI Robotics and EMSTEEL entered a USD 1.2 million strategic deployment agreement for Micropolis to develop, certify, and deploy four M01 autonomous logistics robots plus fleet management and AI platforms in EMSTEEL’s facilities.

press_references.value: Micropolis signs $9.3M development distribution agreement with AfricAI

partnership_announcements.description: Micropolis signed a $9.3M development distribution agreement with AfricAI, establishing a new commercial partnership.

press_references.value: Micropolis AI Robotics and QSS Robotics Sign Letter of Intent to Procure 500 Robots and Expand Autonomous Robotics Technologies in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia

partnership_announcements.description: Micropolis AI Robotics signed a non-binding LOI with QSS Robotics to form a strategic collaboration for distribution, localization, and deployment of Micropolis autonomous robotics technologies across Saudi Arabia, including pilots with Saudi Interior Ministry entities and a potential future purchase of up to 500 robots.

press_references.value: Micropolis Signs Agreement with Helsingborgs Hamn AB and MCS Robotics to Develop and Test the ‘Box Cleaner’ Robot

partnership_announcements.description: Micropolis Holding announced a new partnership with Helsingborgs Hamn AB and MCS Robotics AB to jointly develop and test the autonomous 'Box Cleaner' robot on the Micropolis M2 platform at the Port of Helsingborg.

press_references.value: Micropolis Announces Expansion into Egypt and North Africa Through Exclusive Distribution Agreement with AERXIO

partnership_announcements.description: Micropolis Holding entered an exclusive distribution agreement with AERXIO, appointing it as sole distributor of Micropolis UGVs and related technologies across Egypt and North Africa to accelerate regional expansion.

press_references.value: Micropolis Establishes Strategic Partnership with Hader Security and Communication Systems

partnership_announcements.description: Micropolis and Hader Security and Communication Systems (HSCS) have established a strategic partnership to combine AI, autonomous robotics, and communication technologies, aiming to deliver integrated solutions for public and private sectors globally.

press_references.value: Micropolis Signs Agreement to Deliver Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Robotics Infrastructure for SEE Holding’s Sustainable City 2.0

partnership_announcements.description: Micropolis Holding Company and SEE Holding have signed a non-legally binding Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to collaborate on the deployment of AI and robotics infrastructure for SEE Holding's Sustainable City 2.0 project. The partnership will focus on integrating advanced robotics, AI-powered surveillance, smart mobility, and edge computing into SEE Holding's sustainable city developments globally, and includes a joint R&D program to advance sustainable urban technologies.

press_references.value: Micropolis Robotics Unveils Autonomous Logistics Platform at UMEX 2026 in Abu Dhabi

press_references.value: Micropolis Robotics Unveils New Industrial-Grade, IP67-Rated Computing Module Powered by NVIDIA for Advanced AI Processing of its Robots

product_launches.description: Micropolis Holding launched an industrial-grade, IP67-rated Edge Computing Unit powered by NVIDIA Orin SoC to deliver on-device, low-latency AI processing for its Microspot platform and autonomous robots used in security and law enforcement.

overview_description.description:
Micropolis was founded to make functional transportation safer, cleaner, and more usable. To achieve that goal, the team created a whole new form of transportation.

Micropolis will provide mobility-as-a-service in dense urban environments. We will handle the autonomous control, charging, maintenance, and upgrades for our fleet of vehicles.

In 2020, Micropolis joined forces with Dubai Police. And in the process, solidified the future in the autonomous rover industry. We are focused on testing on private and public roads as we move towards launching the first fleet.

product.name: M-Platform
product.description: A modular autonomous mobile robotic platform for industrial operations, urban logistics, and other applications requiring mobile robotics, AI, and customized hardware or software.

product.name: M-Patrol
product.description: Autonomous security and surveillance vehicles developed for patrol operations, with remote monitoring, AI surveillance, and optional drone integration for police and security organizations.

product.name: Microspot
product.description: An AI security and law-enforcement intelligence platform that integrates patrol vehicles and camera feeds for behavioral analysis, suspect tracking, facial recognition, threat assessment, and real-time reporting.

product.name: Custom Robotics and AI Solutions
product.description: Engineering and manufacturing services that adapt Micropolis robotic platforms with application-specific hardware, AI software, mechanical systems, user interfaces, and back-end applications.
